sourceReleaseArtifacts.rule: Release ZIPs contain code, schemas, migrations, fixtures, synthetic data and non-sensitive registries only.

preDeploymentRequirements: Identify every production data plane affected by the release.
For any server-persistent user, firm, billing, document, analytics or operational data plane, require an external durable store rather than runtime-local ephemeral storage.
Require a current successful backup/snapshot receipt and a tested restore or provider recovery path before applying a state-changing migration.
Classify migrations. Destructive or irreversible migration requires an explicit data-preservation plan, verified backup and rollback/forward-recovery instructions.
Record non-sensitive continuity fingerprints/counts where feasible before and after migration; do not export private row contents into release or CI artifacts.
Do not delete, reset, reseed, truncate or replace production user data merely because a new application version is deployed.
Keep the last accepted-live application commit and the compatible data recovery point separately identifiable.

currentReleaseTruth.navigatorPersistence: runtime-local SQLite remains a reference implementation and is not accepted as durable production persistence
currentReleaseTruth.codeOnlyDeployment: must not claim migration of live user data

publicationGate.rule: Preserve unfinished capability source internally, but do not show ordinary public links, modules, controls, calls-to-action or sales claims until the capability is satisfactorily implemented and tested.
